When_an_HTTP_request_is_received.description: POST an order. An inline map with a C# helper returns the shipping address as one cleaned-up line.

parameters.xslt:
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:msxsl="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:addr="urn:samples:address" exclude-result-prefixes="msxsl addr">
  <xsl:output method="text"/>
  <msxsl:script language="C#" implements-prefix="addr"><![CDATA[
    public string Line(string name, string street, string city, string province, string postalCode)
    {
        var code = Regex.Replace(postalCode ?? "", "[^A-Za-z0-9]", "").ToUpperInvariant();
        if (code.Length == 6) code = code.Substring(0, 3) + " " + code.Substring(3);
        return string.Join(", ", name.Trim().ToUpperInvariant(), street.Trim(), city.Trim() + " " + province.Trim().ToUpperInvariant() + " " + code);
    }
  ]]></msxsl:script>
  <xsl:template match="/Order">
    <xsl:value-of select="addr:Line(string(ShipTo/Name), string(ShipTo/Street), string(ShipTo/City), string(ShipTo/Province), string(ShipTo/PostalCode))"/>
  </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>
